correctness.rationale: Reconstructed real C(Y)→C(X) operator norm as 2(1−inf_x overlap) by Riesz and total variation, with one degree-1 identity component and connected nontrivial degree-d cover. Every continuous X→Z misses the appropriate fiber somewhere because a section of a connected nontrivial covering is impossible; at most two Z-valued approximation maps give lower overlap ≤1−w+w/d. Three Z-valued maps have some coefficient ≥1/3 whose map misses fiber, so overlap ≤min(2/3,2w/d). The two-map persistent-one-sheet and three-map persistent-two-distinct-sheets guarded-transport lemmas construct matching upper bounds for all finite graph covers including loops; the allowed ordered triple move graph is connected for every d by two-symbol six-cycle and overlapping pair connectivity. Their minimum gives 2w(d−1)/d up to w=d/(d+1), and above it 2/3 at d=2 or 2−4w/d at d≥3, including w=0,1. Independently checked the guarded state graph for degrees 2–9 and inspected the source exact-rational 4214 phase identity checker; these finite checks support but do not replace the graph-topological argument.
